clue.text: A bishop accompanying press chief, retired?

definitions.note: having retired for the night, i.e. gone to bed

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
the chief of a newspaper is its editor, abbreviated ED

explanation.surface: A senior churchman keeps company with a newspaper boss who has stepped down from work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' suggests leaving a job; the question mark flags the other sense, going to bed for the night.
explanation.definitionFit: To retire can mean to go to bed, so someone who has retired is lying in bed.

clue.text: Francis's place briefly to help one

indicators.note: said briefly, the word loses its final letter, cut short

parts.note: to help means to assist
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A man called Francis points to a spot where one may lend a hand.
explanation.walkthrough: Saint Francis is the Italian friar from the hill town in Umbria.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Francis, founder of the Franciscan order, was born in and named after this Italian town.

clue.text: Diamonds, for example, that you can wear

definitions.meaning: diamonds is one of the four sets in a pack of playing cards
a jacket-and-trousers outfit worn as clothing

explanation.surface: Jewels are offered as something to put on.
explanation.definitionFit: Diamonds is one of four card categories, and the same word names a matching jacket and trousers outfit.

clue.text: Rick's rant is out of order

indicators.note: letters that are out of order are rearranged into a new sequence

explanation.surface: A man named Rick delivers a tirade that is unacceptable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rick' looks like a name; it is the verb meaning to wrench a muscle, and the 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: To rick a back or neck is to sprain or wrench it, the same injury as pulling a muscle.

clue.text: Finishes with mates?

parts.note: the closing phases of chess matches often conclude with checkmate, not with friends

explanation.surface: Someone wraps things up in the company of friends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mates' looks like friends; in chess a mate ends the play, and the final phase of a match is where it usually comes.
explanation.definitionFit: The final stages of chess matches are where checkmate is typically delivered.

clue.text: Wooden container with lever touching top of light

parts.note: a crowbar used to prise is a bar, a kind of lever
re means about or concerning, i.e. touching on

indicators.note: the top of a down word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A wooden box is fitted with a handle near the upper part of a lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: A cask made of wooden staves is a classic container for beer or wine.

clue.text: Six-act dramas extremely rare? They're no longer screened here

indicators.note: rare as in underdone or unusual, telling us the letters are cooked into a new arrangement
extremely means take only the extreme letters, the first and last

explanation.surface: Plays in six acts are said to be very uncommon.
explanation.walkthrough: Until 2014 British drivers displayed a paper road-tax certificate in the windscreen; 'screened' means shown on a windscreen, not broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: These paper road-tax certificates once had to be displayed on a car windscreen in the UK and were abolished in 2014.

clue.text: Cub: it is desperate for something to eat

indicators.note: desperate suggests wild and frantic, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A young animal is starving and wants food.
explanation.definitionFit: A small baked sweet or savoury snack is certainly a thing one eats.

clue.text: Periodically insular, Liam's girl

indicators.note: periodically means at regular intervals, so take every other letter

explanation.surface: An island-dwelling woman is the girlfriend of a man called Liam.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the second, fourth and sixth letters of 'insular' and carry on alternately into 'Liam'; the Irish name suits a Liam.
explanation.definitionFit: This Irish female first name is a girl's name.

clue.text: A lot of snow, one foot, at end of drive

indicators.note: the following pieces are placed at the end of the first one

parts.note: Dr is the street-name abbreviation for drive
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Heavy snow lies deep at the end of a driveway.
explanation.definitionFit: Wind piles snow into banks, and a deep heap of it is a snowbank.

clue.text: Cross coming out of manger edgeways

indicators.note: the letters come out of the run of text, extracted from inside it

explanation.surface: Someone irritable emerges sideways from a feeding trough.
explanation.definitionFit: Being cross is being annoyed or irritated, the state of having been made furious.

clue.text: Smile when capturing one very loud, winged monster

indicators.note: capturing means holding the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a broad smile is a grin
the Roman numeral for one is I
ff (fortissimo) is the musical direction for very loud

explanation.surface: Someone beams on catching a noisy flying beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The mythical beast with an eagle's head and wings and a lion's body is a winged monster.

clue.text: Bouncer driven away by club?

parts.note: the bouncer is a ball that bounces, the club is a golfer's, and driven means struck off the tee

explanation.surface: A nightclub doorman is chased off by the venue.
explanation.walkthrough: A nightclub bouncer is the picture; the thing that bounces is struck away by a driver on the tee.
explanation.definitionFit: The small dimpled sphere hit off the tee by a driver bounces down the fairway.

clue.text: Polish melody that's very good?

definitions.meaning: to polish here is to make small adjustments for improvement
an excellent melody would be a ...

explanation.surface: A piece of music from Poland is excellent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like the nationality, but it is the verb to refine.
explanation.definitionFit: To refine something with small adjustments, and read as two words, an excellent melody.

clue.text: Spies blemishes on skin

definitions.meaning: spies who infiltrate an organisation from within
small dark raised marks on the skin

explanation.surface: Someone notices spots on another's skin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spies' reads as a verb, notices; it is the noun for double agents.
explanation.definitionFit: Planted secret agents and small dark skin marks share this word.

clue.text: Left university, not returning to see town

indicators.note: returning means the word not is read backwards

explanation.surface: A graduate leaves college and never goes back to visit a town.
explanation.definitionFit: A large town in Bedfordshire, north of London, known for its airport.

clue.text: Tea primarily is an English infusion

indicators.note: primarily means take the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Tea is said to be above all an English brew.
explanation.definitionFit: A herbal tea made by steeping leaves or flowers in hot water is an infusion.

clue.text: They believe Maud, oddly, is losing weight

indicators.note: oddly means take the odd-numbered letters, first and third

parts.note: someone losing weight slims

explanation.surface: A woman named Maud is strangely shedding pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Followers of Islam are believers in one God, so they are people who believe.

clue.text: Chart folded out to see African city

parts.note: a chart is a map

indicators.note: folded suggests the letters are creased into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A map is unfolded to look for a city in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Mozambique is a city in southern Africa.

clue.text: Bogged down as stag may be seasonally?

definitions.meaning: stuck in a dull, unchanging routine
a stag in the autumn mating season, sexually excited

explanation.surface: A deer seems stuck in the mud at certain times of year.
explanation.walkthrough: The rut is the autumn breeding season of deer, when stags are said to be in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Stuck in a groove means stuck in routine; it also describes a male deer during the mating season.

clue.text: Boss, put out, showing one where to get off?

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An irritated boss gestures toward where a passenger should leave.
explanation.definitionFit: Passengers leave a bus at a designated stopping point on the street.

clue.text: Ship, perhaps: empty chair to the back of it?

indicators.note: empty means remove the inside, leaving only the outer letters

parts.note: aft is the nautical word for toward the back of a vessel

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a ship can be moved with a vacant seat at its stern.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel is a kind of boat or other seagoing vehicle, so a ship is an example.

clue.text: Gracious duke seen in tie

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like 'gracious!'

explanation.surface: A kindly duke is seen wearing a necktie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gracious' looks like an adjective for the duke; it is the exclamation, 'goodness gracious', which British slang renders 'cor'.
explanation.definitionFit: A length of string or rope can be used to tie or bind something.

clue.text: Smack, or beat with force pressing down

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece placed below presses down from beneath

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them
g is the symbol for gravitational force

explanation.surface: A slap, or a beating delivered with heavy downward pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smack' looks like a blow, but it is the noun for a taste or flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack of something is a distinctive flavour, a sharp taste.

clue.text: Nothing reflected in French material

indicators.note: reflected as in a mirror, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: nil means nothing
en is French for in

explanation.surface: No fabric is mirrored in a French setting.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloth woven from flax is a fabric, a dress material.

clue.text: Sailor, one of five children, becoming king of Rome

parts.note: tar is a traditional word for a sailor
a quin is a quintuplet, one of five born together

explanation.surface: A seaman who is one of quintuplets rises to rule ancient Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarquinius Superbus was the seventh and last legendary monarch of ancient Rome.
